correctness.rationale: For each exact cutoff 1..4 on the fixed 14-vertex graph, exhaustive independent connected-component algorithms enumerate every face. Complete acyclic matchings on all face incidences leave only one vertex and 1/1/8/6 same-degree cells in degrees 3/5/5/6, proving the integral sphere-wedge homotopy types. Independent GF2 boundary matrices match the Betti numbers. Signed Lefschetz computations verify all D7 characters. Exact filtered boundary reduction verifies the three nonzero finite bar types and the rank-one stage-two-to-three H5 inclusion; torsion-freeness makes the induced integral map nonzero injective.
